question: 查询2026年9月销售额、有效订单数、客单价和购买客户数，不要图表。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(o.paid_amount),2) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' LIMIT 1;

question: 最近7天每天的有效销售额是多少？用线性图展示。
reference_sql: SELECT DATE(o.ordered_at) AS day, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-10-09' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-16' GROUP BY DATE(o.ordered_at) ORDER BY day LIMIT 30;

question: 查询全部数据中每个月的有效销售额，用线性图展示。
reference_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at,'%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.ordered_at,'%Y-%m') ORDER BY month LIMIT 30;

question: 查询2026年9月各品类销售额，用柱状图展示。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.line_paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, p.category LIMIT 10;
check_note: 必须使用明细实付，不能SUM订单金额

question: 查询2026年9月销售额最高的前10件商品，同时显示销量。
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(i.line_paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,p.product_id LIMIT 10;

question: 统计2026年9月各地区的有效销售额，用柱状图展示。
reference_sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,c.region LIMIT 10;

question: 统计2026年9月各渠道的有效销售额占比，用饼图展示。
reference_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,o.channel LIMIT 10;

question: 2026年9月下单的订单，全额退款订单率是多少？不要图表。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid','completed','refunded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid','completed','refunded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0),2) AS refund_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' LIMIT 1;

question: 统计2026年9月各品类估算商品毛利，不要当作净利润。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.line_paid_amount-i.quantity*i.unit_cost),2) AS estimated_gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY estimated_gross_profit DESC,p.category LIMIT 10;

question: 查询最近30天购买金额最高的前10位客户，以及各自有效订单数。
reference_sql: SELECT c.customer_id,c.customer_name,COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count,ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','completed') AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-09-16' AND o.ordered_at < '2026-10-16' GROUP BY c.customer_id,c.customer_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC,c.customer_id LIMIT 10;
